defects_found_and_regressed.observed_problem: Runtime coercion accepted JSON booleans as integers.
defects_found_and_regressed.correction: Reject booleans and numeric strings before Pydantic integer parsing.
defects_found_and_regressed.regression: tests/test_api.py rejects false for arr_usd and active_users.

defects_found_and_regressed.observed_problem: An initial strict-mode correction rejected schema-valid integer-valued numbers such as 2.0.
defects_found_and_regressed.correction: Allow integer-valued JSON numbers while retaining boolean and string rejection.
defects_found_and_regressed.regression: tests/test_api.py accepts 5000.0 and 12.0 and returns integer fields.

provider_correction_during_trial: Captured Uvicorn logs could block the consumer process and Schemathesis NonFatalError events could be misclassified as findings; local corrective commit 751e1f8 and publication candidate fa0296f bound service logs and classify incomplete runs as RUN_ERROR.
limitations: This bounded run covers only GET and POST /api/tickets, not every API operation.
NO_FINDINGS means no issue was observed under these frozen controls; it is not proof that no defect exists.
The reusable GitHub workflow is configured but is not hosted evidence until the provider commit and consumer workflow are pushed and execute on GitHub.
